tei:titleStmt.tei:title: קמע למכשירים שבורים
Amulet bowl formula for exorcising broken or malfunctioning electrical appliances

tei:bibl.tei:title: קמע למכשירים שבורים
Amulet bowl formula for exorcising broken or malfunctioning electrical appliances
tei:bibl.tei:author: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: A friend of mine moving into a new apartment complained that his washing machine was infested by demons. So I made this amulet in the style of the Babylonian magic bowl corpus (specifically, mostly based on the form of JBA 26 (MS 1928/43)) to help him. Then I was asked to upload my amulet text here so I generalized it a bit, vocalized it, and added gender instructions. For maximum efficacy, the text should be written in a spiral pattern in the concave side of an unglazed ceramic bowl and buried face-down at the threshold of your apartment. That being said, my friend just printed the included image out, and the technician managed to find the problem pretty quickly.
Note: I’m using my original system for non-binary Aramaic declension.
